scope: Read-only independent reference-image advisory; no paid jobs submitted or changed. Root already approved and submitted five movement pilots.
decision: All five are readable and usable for the approved movement/style pilots. This is not full-film continuity approval. No extra paid reference retry requested.
method: Actual rendered pixels of all five downloaded images inspected; inherited reference deviations separated from later video motion failures.
video_qa_focus: Two hands remain attached and do not multiply.
Only small tightening and flattening of the existing band; cloth remains supported around the original right arm.
Robot arm stays attached, chest stays closed, one woman and one robot persist.
Lantern keeps its original geometry, ground position and flame; no text or sudden new props.
Preserve each actual reference material and identity during the pilot; record canonical identity and early tower light separately as inherited reference limitations.

records.style_observed: Tactile felt and embroidery, visible seams and threads; clear material distinction from previous ten local versions.
records.anatomy_and_action: One woman and one robot; two readable human hands contacting the existing support band. Robot is elongated with a body seam and long flippers, rather than the locked single sphere.
records.lighting: Distant tower already has a bright warm beacon and horizontal beam. This contradicts the S14 dark-tower story state and is inherited from the reference image.
records.full_film_correction: Darken the distant tower and remove its beam; lock spherical robot proportions across the entire sequence before adopting this shot.

records.style_observed: Backlit leather-puppet scene, visible articulated pivots and cutout profile; layered scenery and single readable composition.
records.anatomy_and_action: Two visible human hands hold the two existing cloth tails. Robot has distinct head/torso, articulated hands and fingers, beyond the canonical sphere and flippers; material interpretation is usable for a movement trial.
records.lighting: Distant tower aperture is already warm and luminous. The bright stage backlight can be a medium convention, but the explicit lit tower conflicts with S14.
records.full_film_correction: Keep the stage medium but make the tower lamp visibly dark; lock a consistent spherical or explicitly redesigned puppet robot before all 30 beats.

records.style_observed: Prussian-blue graphic illustration on a pale paper border, closer to cyanotype-inspired illustration than photographic cyanotype.
records.anatomy_and_action: One woman, one elongated rounded robot and a single lantern. Both hands visibly engage the band; long robot arms and tiny fingers differ from original short flippers.
records.lighting: Tower aperture is pale like other paper highlights; illumination is ambiguous without an obvious projected beam. Do not rate this alone as proven premature light.
records.full_film_correction: Choose whether illustration is the intended medium and label accurately. Lock proportions and ensure the tower aperture stays dark until S25.

records.style_observed: Credible live-action woman, natural hands, wet masonry and a physical cream-enamel robot prop; distinct from animation styles.
records.anatomy_and_action: Hands grasp the existing band around an attached arm. The robot has a separate head and torso and articulated arms rather than one sphere; acceptable as a deliberate pilot prop variant only.
records.lighting: A visible warm point at the distant tower top reads as an already lit beacon, contrary to S14.
records.full_film_correction: Turn the distant beacon off and establish the final robot prop design consistently before producing full narrative coverage.

records.style_observed: Clear carved wood and inlaid miniature architecture; fabric band distinct from wood, readable grain and carved face.
records.anatomy_and_action: Two human hands contact the existing fabric support. Robot has head/torso segmentation and no small mouth; woman has swept hair instead of blunt fringe. These are initial reference deviations, not video-model failures.
records.lighting: Distant tower top already has a warm beacon. Foreground lantern is correctly lit; tower is premature for S14.
records.full_film_correction: Darken the distant tower and lock the chosen wooden character design, including face, hair and robot shape, throughout all 30 beats.
